newsitem.title: USA: AlliedSignal buys Cabot's zirconium unit.
newsitem.headline: AlliedSignal buys Cabot's zirconium unit.

text.p: AlliedSignal Inc said Wednesday it had bought the zirconium products business of Cabot Corp for undisclosed terms.
AlliedSignal said it bought Cabot's potassium zirconium fluoride and hydrofluorozirconic acid products produced in Pennsylvania.

AlliedSignal said it would shift production of these products, used primarily in the aluminum industry, to its specialty chemicals facility in Germany, which makes and markets similar products under the Riedel-de Haen brand name.
"Salts" like potassium zirconium fluoride are used as metal fluxing agents in aluminum/zirconium alloys, for aircraft applications and as a flame retardant for wool.

"Acids" like hydrofluorozirconic acid are used for the pre-treatment of metals and for finishing applications, on surfaces of automotive panels and as a layer on aluminum and phosphated steel, the company said.
